dedupe_keys.name: ultrawide band low polarization sensitivity 3 m soi arrayed waveguide gratings

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The case tests a fabricated 1-by-12 arrayed waveguide grating with 100-GHz spacing on a 3-micrometre silicon-on-insulator platform. Coverage extends from O through L bands and includes insertion loss, crosstalk, polarisation sensitivity and actual 10, 20 and 35 Gb/s NRZ-OOK transmission. The source reports error-free operation at a BER of 10^-9 with rate-dependent power penalties. These measurements establish a communications testbed; they do not establish an operational carrier installation or standalone public measurement dataset. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The experiment assesses communication system performance of the fabricated multiplexing component.
